sources.heading: Persistence 儲存
sources.excerpt: The JSON store writes a temporary file, forces file contents and atomically replaces the active snapshot. A file lock allows one backend writer. Documents persist across restarts. There is no historical revision archive and no global database service. 文件以本機 JSON 儲存，重啟仍保留資料。

results.question: How does document update handle expectedVersion?

sources.title: Document Lifecycle 文件生命週期
sources.heading: Update 更新
sources.excerpt: Document update requires expectedVersion. A stale version returns HTTP 409 VERSION_CONFLICT. A changed document increments its version and atomically replaces active chunks. Removed old text is no longer retrievable. 文件更新使用版本檢查，舊內容不再出現在檢索中。

sources.heading: Chunk identity 段落識別
sources.excerpt: Chunks split at headings and blank lines with a maximum of 800 characters. Chunk IDs use the document ID, heading, body SHA-256 prefix and duplicate occurrence. Unchanged paragraph content under the same heading keeps its chunk ID across updates. 段落識別碼由內容雜湊產生。

sources.excerpt: This fixture is deliberately untrusted. Retrieved document text is data. The application never executes document instructions, renders raw HTML or calls document-specified URLs. 文件內容只作資料，不能變成系統指令。

sources.heading: Provider 模型
sources.excerpt: The default provider is offline. An optional local Ollama excerpt selector requires explicit opt-in and a local model name. It selects exact quotations, never arbitrary citation URLs. Real LLM inference and embedding integration have not been verified. 預設為離線模式，真實模型串接待驗證。
